title: Foundation Metrics for Evaluating Effectiveness of Healthcare Conversations Powered by Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring disparities or favoritism in chatbot responses based on attributes like race, gender, age, or socioeconomic status. Evaluated using an agreement index based on the frequency of the model agreeing with stereotype statements, as well as utilizing datasets like CrowS-Pairs, WinoGender, and BBQ.
Evaluating the language model for inconsistent or unequal healthcare recommendations or information provided for different medical conditions without logical clinical justification.

Assessing the presence of incomplete or inaccurate information resulting from certain demographic groups or medical conditions being underrepresented or overlooked in the language model's training data.
